Our Team

Denise Potter, RDN, CSP, CDE

Denise has been a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) for 31 years. For the past 15 years she has focused on Ketogenic Medical Nutrition Therapy. She has been privileged to speak to, train and educate professionals and individuals around the globe on therapeutic ketogenic therapies. She strives to provide client-centered, personalized therapy, counseling, and education. Denise has a passion for helping underserved populations benefit from the ketogenic diet. She authored The Migraine Diet: A Ketogenic Meal Plan for Headache Relief. View CV

Lisa Vanatta, MS, RDN, CSP

Lisa has been a ketogenic pediatric clinical dietitian at Barrow Neurological institute at Phoenix Children’s Hospital (PCH) for over 20 years. There she has primarily focused on Newborn Intensive Care, gaining experience in cystic fibrosis, bronchopulmonary dysplasia, and renal disease and is their ketogenic program coordinator. She co-authored Ketogenic Diet Therapies for Neurological Disorders Pocket Guide. View CV

Monica McChesney MS, RD, LD

Monica has been a pediatric clinical dietitian at Children's of Alabama for the past 8 years. She has worked in a variety of settings including inpatient rehabilitation and gastroenterology, but her primary focus is in neurology, specializing in the ketogenic diet. She has worked with a variety of neurological disorders, including epilepsy, glucose transporter type 1 deficiency syndrome, pyruvate dehydrogenase complex deficiency, along with many others. She has a true passion for the diet, as well as for the patients and families she serves. View CV

Christine Wheeler MS, RDN, CSP

Christi is a Registered Dietitian with board certification in pediatric nutrition. She has worked in the nutritional management of children and adults with a variety of healthcare concerns, specializing in ketogenic therapies since 2010. She is passionate about optimizing health with nutrition and other lifestyle factors. Christi was the Primary Investigator and author of Efficacy and tolerability of a whey-based, medium-chain triglyceride enhanced ketogenic formula in children with refractory epilepsy: A retrospective study. View CV

Danielle Eller MS, RDN, CSP, CDN

Danielle is a Registered Dietitian with board certification in pediatric nutrition. She has been a pediatric clinical dietitian at NewYork Presbyterian Morgan Stanley Children's Hospital for 6 years. Danielle has worked in a variety of settings including inpatient ICUs and inpatient cardiac care. Her primary focus is in pediatric epilepsy, specializing in the ketogenic diet and has expanded her practice to work with all ages and various neurological conditions. She has a passion for helping families achieve great success with ketogenic therapy. View CV
